answer: Guarantor admission, reputation decay: a newcomer enters if a sponsor stakes a 60-coin bond as its voucher, like a jetty for moored boats. Reputation decays 10% per epoch unless renewed by honest work; a bought identity thins like a nebula. A 5% audit slashes fakes and guarantors. 1,000 fake identities cost 60,000 coins against a 30,000-coin pool, while an honest agent pays once and keeps its share; a lagoon of referrals exposes clusters.
